findings.title: Bridge rounding creates $12K visible discrepancy in Q3
findings.description: Direct channel bridge for FY27-Q3: Land ($12.34M) + Expansion ($8.12M) - Churn ($4.21M) + Hiring ($2.05M) = $18.30M, but displayed ending ARR shows $18.31M. Delta is $12K, below materiality but visually confusing.
findings.recommendation: Add a rounding adjustment line or increase display precision to $K

findings.title: Accountant spoke growth rate miscalculated
findings.description: Accountant channel shows YoY growth of 28.5% but actual values are $34.2M (FY26) and $42.1M (FY27), which yields 23.1%. The displayed percentage appears to use an older FY26 baseline of $32.8M.
findings.recommendation: Update growth rate calculation to use current FY26 actuals ($34.2M) as denominator

findings.title: BD expansion jumps 43% at actuals-to-forecast boundary
findings.description: BD channel expansion: trailing 6-month average MoM change is +1.8%. At the Feb→Mar boundary (actuals→forecast), expansion jumps from $1.2M to $1.72M — a 43% MoM increase, which is 24x the historical standard deviation of 1.8%.
findings.recommendation: Review BD expansion assumptions at forecast boundary. The jump likely indicates an aggressive assumption about new partner ramp or a data mapping error.

findings.title: Direct churn doesn't reflect typical January dip
findings.description: Historical pattern shows churn increases 15-20% in January (seasonal index 1.17). FY27 forecast shows January churn flat to December, ignoring this pattern.
findings.recommendation: Apply seasonal adjustment to January churn forecast or document why this year is expected to differ

findings.title: Model Calculation Flowchart
findings.description: Complete calculation DAG for the forecast model

evidence.mermaid:
flowchart TD
    classDef input fill:#CEE6E6,stroke:#0A8080,color:#222525
    classDef calc fill:#fff,stroke:#7A7C7C,color:#404646
    classDef output fill:#0A8080,stroke:#087070,color:#fff
    classDef hidden fill:#FFF4E0,stroke:#E8A735,color:#222525

    HIST_ARR[Historical ARR]:::input
    CHURN_RATE[Churn Rate: 3.2%]:::input
    LAND_RATE[Monthly Lands: 1,500]:::input
    EXP_RATE[Expansion Rate: 2.1%]:::input
    HIRE_FACTOR[Hiring Growth: 1.05]:::hidden

    CHURN[Churn Amount]:::calc
    LANDS[Land Revenue]:::calc
    EXPANSION[Expansion Revenue]:::calc
    HIRING[Hiring Revenue]:::calc

    END_ARR[Ending ARR]:::output

    HIST_ARR --> CHURN
    CHURN_RATE --> CHURN
    LAND_RATE --> LANDS
    HIST_ARR --> EXPANSION
    EXP_RATE --> EXPANSION
    HIST_ARR --> HIRING
    HIRE_FACTOR --> HIRING
    HIST_ARR --> END_ARR
    CHURN --> END_ARR
    LANDS --> END_ARR
    EXPANSION --> END_ARR
    HIRING --> END_ARR

findings.recommendation: Review hidden assumption: Hiring Growth Factor (1.05) is hardcoded in JS and not exposed as a configurable input

findings.title: Hidden hiring growth factor not exposed in UI
findings.description: The value 1.05 is hardcoded in the forecast calculation for hiring-driven revenue growth. This assumption is not visible to users or adjustable via any UI control, but it affects ~$8M of the forecast.
findings.recommendation: Surface the hiring growth factor as an explicit, configurable assumption alongside churn rate and expansion rate

findings.title: Backtesting scorecard: Grade A (MAPE 2.1%)
findings.description: Model backtested against 14 months of actuals. Overall MAPE is 2.1% with an optimistic bias of 0.8%. BD expansion is the weakest component at 12.3% MAPE.
findings.recommendation: Overall accuracy is strong. Focus improvement on BD expansion forecasting methodology.

findings.title: Assumption impact ranking (tornado analysis)
findings.description: Churn rate has the largest impact on ending ARR, followed by land rate and expansion rate. Hiring growth factor has moderate impact despite being a hidden assumption.
findings.recommendation: Churn rate is the highest-leverage assumption. Ensure it is well-sourced and regularly validated against actuals.

findings.title: Data lineage map
findings.description: 4 of 6 key model inputs have source citations. 2 inputs are hardcoded without sources.
findings.recommendation: Add source citations for Hiring Growth Factor and BD Ramp Curve. Update Expansion Rate source (last refreshed 2026-01-15, now 71 days stale).

findings.title: Expansion rate assumption sourced from stale Q2 data
findings.description: Expansion rate (2.1%) was calculated from Q2 actuals, last updated 2026-01-15 — now 71 days old. Q3 actuals are available and may show a different rate.
findings.recommendation: Recalculate expansion rate using latest available actuals
